title.target: Third conditional: what would have happened
title.en: Third conditional: what would have happened

ex.ko: 나는 그 직장을 그만둔 것을 후회해요.

ex.t: If I had taken a taxi, I wouldn't have missed the train.

ex.t: If the result had been good, she would have been happy.
ex.ko: 시험 결과가 좋았더라면 그녀는 기뻐했을 거예요.

ex.t: If we hadn't made that mistake, we would have won.
ex.ko: 그 실수를 안 했더라면 우리가 이겼을 거예요.

ex.t: If I hadn't met him by chance, we wouldn't have become friends.
ex.ko: 우연히 그를 만나지 않았더라면 우리는 친구가 되지 못했을 거예요.

ex.t: If we had left early, we would have avoided the traffic.
ex.ko: 일찍 출발했더라면 교통 체증을 피했을 거예요.

ex.t: If he had worn a helmet, he wouldn't have got hurt.
ex.ko: 헬멧을 썼더라면 그는 다치지 않았을 거예요.

ex.t: If only I had studied harder then.
ex.ko: 그때 더 열심히 공부했더라면 좋았을 텐데.

ex.t: If I had chosen another path, everything would have been different.
ex.ko: 다른 길을 택했다면 모든 것이 달라졌을 거예요.

title.ko: 제3조건문 if + had + p.p., would have + p.p.
title.en: third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + past participle

explain.ko: 과거에 실제로 일어나지 않은 일을 가정해 그 결과를 말할 때 제3조건문을 씁니다. 형태는 if + had + 과거분사, would have + 과거분사입니다. 부정은 hadn't + 과거분사 / wouldn't have + 과거분사로 말합니다. if절을 뒤에 써도 되며 그때는 쉼표가 필요 없습니다. 지금까지 이어지는 결과는 would + 동사원형(If I had taken the job, I would be living in Paris now)으로 말할 수 있습니다. If only I had ...는 강한 후회를 나타냅니다.
explain.en: Use the third conditional to imagine a different past and its result. Form: if + past perfect, would have + past participle. Negatives: hadn't + past participle / wouldn't have + past participle. The if-clause can come second, with no comma. A result that continues now takes would + base verb: If I had taken the job, I would be living in Paris now. If only I had ... expresses a strong regret.

head: 구조 / Structure
형태 / Form
예문 / Example
rows: If + had + p.p., would have + p.p.
If I had left early, I would have caught the train.
If + hadn't + p.p., wouldn't have + p.p.
If we hadn't made that mistake, we wouldn't have lost.
If + had + p.p., would + base verb
If I had taken the job, I would be living in Paris now.
If only I had studied harder.

notes.ko: 실제로 일어나지 않은 과거의 일에만 씁니다. 지나간 일은 바꿀 수 없다는 느낌이 있습니다.
notes.en: It is only for unreal past situations; the past cannot be changed.

notes.ko: if절 안에는 would have를 쓰지 않습니다. If I would have left… 는 틀린 표현입니다.
notes.en: Do not use would have in the if-clause: If I would have left… is wrong.

notes.ko: could have / might have로 가능성을 약하게 말할 수도 있습니다.
notes.en: You can use could have / might have for weaker possibilities.

prompt.ko: 과거의 후회나 놓친 기회에 대해 제3조건문을 사용해 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about a past regret or a missed chance, using the third conditional.

task.model: If I had taken a taxi, I wouldn't have missed the train. I would have arrived on time. If I had got the job, I would be living in Paris now. If only I had left earlier.

model_trans.ko: 택시를 탔더라면 기차를 놓치지 않았을 거예요. 그랬다면 제시간에 도착했을 거예요. 그 직장을 얻었더라면 지금 파리에 살고 있을 거예요. 그때 더 일찍 출발했더라면 좋았을 텐데.
model_trans.en: If I had taken a taxi, I wouldn't have missed the train. I would have arrived on time. If I had got the job, I would be living in Paris now. If only I had left earlier.
